summary: High Court Justice Alex Stein rejected an interim-order request challenging the civilian powers granted to Smotrich as a minister in the Defense Ministry and ordered NIS 3,000 costs.
notes: Renewed historical search again confirms the reported May 10 decision denied interim relief without addressing the petition's prospects or merits. No final merits judgment on this candidate was recovered in this pass. Preserve as limiting/exculpatory procedural status only: it is neither an adverse accountability finding nor a merits validation of the arrangement.
